name: WebinarIgnition – Live & Automated Webinars for WooCommerce
author: Saleswonder Team: Tobias

sections.description:
WebinarIgnition for WooCommerce lets you run unlimited LIVE WEBINARS, AUTOMATED WEBINARS, and EVERGREEN WEBINARS on WordPress. Sell with WooCommerce, Digistore24, Stripe, or PayPal embedded directly in your webinar room, instead of redirecting to a separate checkout page.

New! Innovation AI Webinar

Get free AI texted reminder mails and 3 registration templates with content that fits to you. By just answer 3 questions and add a link.

🎥 Step-by-Step Setup Playlist (AI in the 3. video):
Watch the complete guide (13 videos):

Use WebinarIgnition to host live, automated, and evergreen webinars for small groups or large audiences, while offering products and services during the session. Add interactive polls, group chat, and unlimited call-to-actions (CTAs) for engagement. Set up 1-click registration, custom forms, automated email reminders, and real-time analytics. Integrate with page builders such as Elementor, Thrive, Gutenberg, Divi, and Beaver Builder. Configure multilingual support and GDPR-friendly data handling on your own WordPress site.

Start your 30-day free trial and unlock every feature – with easy onboarding, help with setup, and a $99 savings available directly inside the plugin.

Ideal for WooCommerce stores, agencies, course creators, and marketers who want more control over webinar marketing and sales automation inside WordPress.

WooCommerce Webinar Plugin: Sell Inside Your Webinars

WebinarIgnition embeds WooCommerce checkout directly inside your webinar room. Display offers, forms, bookings, and checkout at key moments during your presentation to increase sales during the webinar. Auto-fill customer details (name, email, address) for a smoother purchase experience.

Live & Automated Webinar Solution for WordPress

Run live webinars for product launches, automated webinars for sales funnels, and evergreen webinars that sell 24/7. Perfect for WooCommerce shop owners, agencies, course creators, and marketers who need flexible, scalable, high-converting webinar sales automation.

Start your 30-day free PLUS trial today—access all features, unlimited CTAs, WooCommerce checkout inside webinars, webhooks, analytics, and Done4U setup service. Start directly in the plugin with additional discount.

LIVE DEMO WEBINARS

  • For WooCommerce Agencies: Ever Feel Like Every Client Project Starts From Zero?
  • For WooCommerce Shop Owners: Triple Your WooCommerce Sales in Just 30 Minutes
  • For German Woocommerce Shop Owners: Wednesday at 6:30 p.m. Berlin Time (CET) in German.
  • Demo Site (Automated & Evergreen Examples): https://demo.webinarignition.com/
  • Meet us: https://webinarignition.com/meet-us/

HIGHLIGHTED BENEFITS

  • Sell WooCommerce products inside webinars (no redirect, fewer checkout drop-offs)
  • Support higher conversion rates with mid-webinar sales and in-room checkout
  • Auto-fill customer details (name, email, address from registration or existing WooCommerce account)
  • Unlimited CTAs & automation tools (polls, forms, checkout, booking—unlimited interactions)
  • Upsell funnel plugin compatible — sell unlimited times during one webinar
  • No monthly platform fees (one-time or $99/mo, vs $300-500/mo external platforms)
  • No attendee limits (scale from 10 to 10,000+ participants)
  • Unlimited evergreen + live webinars (automate sales 24/7 or go live anytime)
  • Any design, any page builder (Elementor, Thrive, Gutenberg, Divi, Beaver Builder)
  • Built-in GDPR & privacy compliance (all data stays on your WordPress server, double opt-in before being added as participant)

Boost Conversion Rates with Mid-Webinar Checkout

How WebinarIgnition can improve the checkout experience:

  • External platforms: Often redirect attendees to separate checkout pages, which can lead to drop-offs.
  • WebinarIgnition: Keeps WooCommerce checkout inside the webinar room, helping reduce friction for interested buyers.
  • Auto-fill existing customer data: Logged-in WooCommerce customers can have name, email, and address pre-filled to speed up checkout.

FREE VS. ULTIMATE PLUS TRIAL (30 DAYS)

FREE VERSION:

  • Unlimited webinars (all types: live, automated, evergreen)
  • Unlimited attendees
  • ONE CTA/action per event inside webinar
  • All automated email reminders (confirmation, 1 day before, 1 hour before, when live, after webinar—fully customizable) OR use your own notification service via webhooks
  • Custom registration forms (fields, drag & drop): first name, last name, email, participant reason, UTM parameters, custom fields
  • Standard analytics
  • One-click registration (live/auto)
  • Multilingual support (see below)
  • Page builder support with shortcodes/templates
  • Social registration available via external plugin: Nextend Social Login (free or paid once under $50, seamlessly integrated, 22+ providers: Facebook, Google, Instagram, etc.)

30-DAY ULTIMATE PLUS TRIAL:

Everything in Free, plus:

  • UNLIMITED CTAs/actions per webinar event (internal & external)
  • WooCommerce/Digistore24/Stripe/PayPal checkout inside webinar with custom triggers/forms
  • Auto-fill customer details (name, email, address for existing WooCommerce customers)
  • Bulk participant import/export with CSV mapping and lead sending
  • Webhooks for CRM/email sync and automations: send all registration data (name, email, reason, UTM parameters, personalized unique registration link, webinar start date&time in machine format) to start your own reminder funnel—plus webhook triggers for registered, attended, and paid (with pixel tracking WP site/WooCommerce sales)
  • Full analytics/funnel + exports (for advanced user session tracking and split testing, use external plugins like Nelio A/B Testing, or the built-in leads tracking from Groundhogg: https://www.groundhogg.io/aff/487/)
  • One-click registration for ALL event types (send personalized links in emails for instant registration)
  • Built-in 100ms video meetings (external service, seamlessly integrated, up to 10,000 participants, 10K free min/month)
  • Done4U setup service: SMTP configuration, email marketing connection, video conversion, registration page design, streaming provider setup, WordPress.com hosting recommendations, consultation, and contacts for sales trainers and webinar content creators
  • Priority support

See all plan details: https://webinarignition.com/#pricing

Webinar Sales Funnel Automation for WooCommerce Stores

WebinarIgnition integrates seamlessly with:

  • WooCommerce (native checkout, product catalog, subscriptions, upsells, auto-fill customer data)
  • Marketing automation tools (webhooks to ActiveCampaign, Mailchimp, Mautic, KlickTipp, FluentCRM)
  • Upsell funnel plugins (CartFlows, FunnelKit, WPFunnels)
  • Payment gateways (Digistore24, Stripe, PayPal, direct integration)
  • Page builders (Elementor, Thrive Architect, Gutenberg, Divi, Beaver Builder, Oxygen)

MULTILINGUAL SUPPORT

Fully translatable and localized. Each webinar can be in a different language with its own date/time format and timezone. Easily add new translations using the free Loco Translate plugin, with built-in auto-translate support via DeepL, Microsoft, and ChatGPT.

Hand translated: English (en_US), German (de_DE)

Machine-translated (DeepL/Microsoft): Spanish (es_ES, es_MX), French (fr_FR), Italian (it_IT), Dutch (nl_NL), Portuguese (pt_BR), Russian (ru_RU), Chinese (zh_CN), Hindi (hi_IN), Turkish (tr_TR), Ukrainian (uk), Hungarian (hu_HU), Croatian (hr), Japanese (ja), Urdu (ur)

More languages on request (free).

MAIN FEATURES

  • Unlimited live, evergreen, and automated/paid webinars
  • Registration, participation, and checkout directly in the event (no redirects, trial/plus)
  • WooCommerce/Digistore24/Stripe/PayPal checkout forms and CTAs (trial/plus)
  • Unlimited CTAs/actions, timed offers, forms, polling, and bookings (trial/plus)
  • Auto-fill existing customer details (name, email, address) for WooCommerce users (trial/plus)
  • Full page-builder integration: Elementor, Gutenberg, Thrive, Beaver, Divi, etc.
  • Customizable participant/registration fields: first name, last name, email, participant reason, UTM parameters, custom fields
  • Admin choice: use built-in email notifications OR send all data via webhooks to your external notification service
  • GDPR/DACH/EU, double opt-in (before saving any data)/consent fields, all data stays on your server
  • Access to 60,000+ WordPress plugins for personalized interactions
  • Social registration via Nextend Social Login plugin (external, seamlessly integrated, free or paid once under $50)
  • Video meetings via 100ms service (external, seamlessly integrated, trial/plus includes 10K free minutes/month)
sections.installation:
1. Download, upload, or install via WordPress Plugins > Add New > WebinarIgnition
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Start your 30-day free trial (directly inside the plugin with discount) to unlock all features: unlimited CTAs, WooCommerce checkout inside webinars, webhooks, analytics, Done4U setup
  4. Complete onboarding wizard in quick start videos in dashboard (set up your first event)
  5. Customize registration, webinar, thank-you, and CTA pages with shortcodes or templates
  6. Configure mail delivery (SMTP) OR set up webhooks to use your own notification service
  7. Optional: Install Nextend Social Login for social registration (free or paid once under $50)
  8. Optional: Book a free onboarding call or use Done4U setup service (included with Ultimate Plus trial)
sections.faq:
What payment and checkout integrations are supported?

WooCommerce, Digistore24, Stripe, PayPal inside webinar room (trial/plus only). Free version can link via button to external checkout pages.

Can I sell WooCommerce products inside a webinar?

Yes! WebinarIgnition embeds WooCommerce checkout directly in the webinar room—no redirects, no drop-off. Proven to boost conversion rates from 10% to 55%. Auto-fills customer details (name, email, address) for existing WooCommerce customers who are logged in during registration.

How do I create an automated webinar sales funnel in WordPress?

Use WebinarIgnition’s evergreen webinar feature with WooCommerce integration. Set up timed CTAs, automated email sequences (or send 1-click registration links via your own email service using webhooks), and integrate with CartFlows, FunnelKit, or WPFunnels for complete sales funnel automation.

What’s the best WordPress plugin for mid-webinar sales?

WebinarIgnition is the only plugin that allows WooCommerce checkout embedded inside the webinar—sell products, tickets, subscriptions, and upsells without redirecting attendees. Auto-fills details entered in registration (name, email, participant reason) and existing WooCommerce customer data (name, email, address) for logged-in users.

Can I automate webinar funnels with WooCommerce?

Yes, with 1-click registration links inside emails, webhooks, email automation, evergreen scheduling, and unlimited CTAs. Integrate with CartFlows, FunnelKit, or WPFunnels for complete sales funnel automation. Use webhooks to trigger personalized emails with unique registration links.

Does WebinarIgnition work with WooCommerce subscriptions?

Yes, sell subscription products directly inside your webinars. Perfect for membership sites, SaaS, and recurring revenue models.

Can the design be fully customized?

Yes! Embed registration/events using shortcodes in any WordPress page builder or theme (Elementor, Thrive, Gutenberg, Divi, Beaver Builder, Oxygen).

How are CTAs and offers shown?

As a sidebar, tab, overlay, direct embed, or timed pop-up (choose for each event). Unlimited CTAs in trial/plus.

What languages are built in?

English (en_US, hand-translated), German (de_DE, hand-translated), and 14 machine-translated languages: Spanish (es_ES, es_MX), French (fr_FR), Italian (it_IT), Dutch (nl_NL), Russian (ru_RU), Chinese (zh_CN), Hindi (hi_IN), Turkish (tr_TR), Ukrainian (uk), Portuguese (pt_BR), Urdu (ur), Hungarian (hu_HU), Croatian (hr), Japanese (ja). Request additional languages free via support.

Can each webinar have a different language, timezone, and date format?

Yes. Each webinar can be set to a different language, timezone, and date/time format. All webinar content, registration forms, emails, and even admin settings for that event will display in the selected language and format.

Can I customize registration fields for different webinars?

Yes. Each webinar can have custom registration fields: first name, last name, email, participant reason (why they’re attending), UTM parameters (for tracking marketing campaigns), and additional custom fields. Export this data (trial/plus) to segment attendees in your CRM or email tool.

Can I use my own email notification service instead of built-in reminders?

Yes. Admin can choose to use built-in email notifications OR send all registration data (name, email, reason, UTM parameters, personalized unique registration link, webinar start date&time in machine format, etc.) via webhooks to an external notification service. This lets you start your own reminder funnel in your preferred email marketing platform. With the start date&time, you can trigger emails before and after the webinar and even create conditions like “registered and not attended.”

How do I bulk import/export leads?

Trial/Plus allows full mapping and import/export in bulk with CSV files. Import on Live only.

What email reminders are included?

All plans include automated email reminders: registration confirmation, 1 day before, 1 hour before, when live, after webinar—fully customizable timing. Alternatively, use webhooks to send data to your own notification service. With webhook triggers (registered, attended, paid—tracked via pixel for WP site/WooCommerce sales), you can create complex automation like “registered and not attended” follow-ups.

What is social registration?

Social registration lets attendees register using Facebook, Google, Instagram, and 22+ other providers via the Nextend Social Login plugin (external, seamlessly integrated, free or paid once under $50). Works with all WebinarIgnition versions.

What is Done4U setup service?

Ultimate Plus includes personal technical setup by our team: SMTP configuration, email marketing connection, video source conversion, registration page design, streaming provider setup, WordPress.com hosting recommendations, and consultation. We also share contacts for sales trainers and webinar content creators to help you succeed.

What is the upgrade path after trial?

Most hosts and admins use the 30-day trial to make their first sales, then stay with the paid license. You’ll get a “trial ends soon” reminder. After the trial ends, the paid license starts automatically, and your site keeps all paid features: unlimited and external CTAs, analytics, webhooks, bulk import/export, payment checkout inside webinar, Done4U setup. You can cancel or manage your license anytime at https://webinarignition.com/members/#!/login.

Is WebinarIgnition GDPR and privacy compliant?

Yes. All registration and attendee data stays on your WordPress server, with double opt-in before being added as a participant. Forms include opt-in/consent fields and compliance options for EU/DACH.

Can I report security bugs?

Yes. Please report through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program.

EXTERNAL SERVICES

This plugin may connect to external services depending on your configuration:

  • Freemius: licensing/updates/trial management (privacy)
  • 100ms Video Meetings: built-in video (trial/plus) (privacy)
  • Google APIs: calendar, YouTube Live, Meet (optional) (privacy)
  • Stripe: payment processing (optional) (privacy)
  • Social Login (Nextend Social Login plugin): Facebook, Google, Instagram, 22+ more (optional/external)
  • CDN resources: Bootstrap, Video.js, jQuery, Moment.js, Luxon

No participant data is sent to external services without your explicit configuration.

DOMAIN USAGE DISCLOSURE

WebinarIgnition may connect to:

  • freemius.com (licensing, required)
  • 100ms.live (video meetings, optional)
  • googleapis.com (calendar/YouTube/Meet, optional)
  • stripe.com (payments, optional)
  • Social login provider domains (optional, via external plugin)
  • CDN domains for libraries
